plans.name: Premium
quotes: Plan includes 10,000 contacts. Select your audience size to calculate your price. The monthly email send limit for Premium plans is 15 times your maximum contact count.

plans.name: Standard
quotes: Plan includes 500 contacts. Select your audience size to calculate your price. The monthly email send limit for Standard plans is 12 times your maximum contact count.

notes: Prices are 'Then, starts at $X /month' and scale with a contacts selector (Standard default 500 contacts, Premium 10,000). A promo shows 15% off the first 12 months for 10,000+ contacts: Premium $297.50, Standard $17, Essentials $11.05; recorded the regular 'starts at' prices. Only monthly billing is shown (annual plans via sales). A separate calculator block in the snapshot shows Premium '$0' and 'Send up to 0 emails' — a broken/unhydrated widget, ignored.
